verdict.rationale: First-party docs say WezTerm natively multiplexes panes, tabs and windows locally and remotely, and its CLI can manipulate tabs and panes. Users independently report splitting and resizing many panes quickly and fully replacing tmux, and a runtime probe confirmed pane spawning and window/tab/pane enumeration via the built-in mux. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the pane-split actions and keybindings themselves (the docs cited only mention panes generically).
